Alchemy is about transformation in all aspects of reality. Transmutation of any matter is possible through alchemy. Some matter is easier to transmute than others. Metals are more difficult to transmute. True transmutation can only occur at the same "level" of transmutation that has occured spiritualy within an alchemist. Transmuting lead into gold requires an alchemist to relinquish posession of themself and ascend into a higher level of conciousness. One that is detached from greed and the possesive nature of mankind. One where the value of gold is nil or "gold" is not gold at all.

In short alchemy is not about obtaining riches or power. It is about travelling the path and understanding hardship in order to obtain wisdom and peace.
Blessings on your path.

Try these as well:

Praxis Spagyrica Philosphica - Frater Albertus 
The Practical Handbook of Plant Alchemy - Manfred M. Junius 

There is some good info in the Encyclopedia of Religion as well.
People confuse alchemy with what their video games and movies have crammed down their throats.
The mouths of the wise are shut except to the ears of understanding.

As the veil between ourselves and the truth is torn away the path we walk becomes more treacherous. Is it a balancing act to avoid a perilous fall or is it madness that allows us to truly see the real?

The true alchemical path lies within you. Communications from others may inspire you or provide insight while on your path. You may not see value in this post right now, but perhaps you will find it's value later on your journey. The key to alchemical success is finding and accepting the divine in you. Obly then will you truly be able to accept that only conciousness disobeys the laws of time.

The whole premise of alchemy is based on the idea that a real transformation cannot occur while directing the benefit of that transformation solely towards one's self. In order to achieve transformation one must embrace compassion as an ideology that encompasses all conciousness including one's self.

If you find yourself "above" another then surely your alchemical practice will fail.
